name: NEO-M9N-00B
title: NEO-M9N-00B: L1 multi-constellation standard precision GNSS receiver module, professional grade
summary: A 12.2 × 16.0 mm, 24-pad LCC module that receives GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou on L1 at the same time, plus SBAS and QZSS, and gives position to 2.0 m CEP at up to 25 Hz. It is built on the u-blox M9 platform (UBX-M9140-KB chip) with a SAW filter, LTE B13 notch and LNA ahead of the chip, a TCXO, an RTC crystal and SPI flash. It runs from 2.7 to 3.6 V and talks over UART, I2C, SPI (selected by D_SEL) or full-speed USB, using UBX, NMEA and RTCM 3.3. An external antenna connects at RF_IN; VCC_RF and LNA_EN feed and switch an active antenna or external LNA.
key_figures: GPS/QZSS L1C/A, GLONASS L1OF, Galileo E1-B/C, BeiDou B1I

notes: The product name is PPP-TG(G)V (NEO-M9N): form factor NEO, platform M9, variant N (standard precision, with SAW and LNA). The ordering code adds NNQ, the major product version (00) and grade letter (A automotive, B professional, C standard). The type number adds XX, the hardware and firmware revision (00).
Product status of NEO-M9N-00B-00: mass production. IN/PCN references UBX-21029274, UBX-22039049, UBX-23000084.

pins.name: SAFEBOOT_N
pins.function: Safe-boot input, used for firmware updates and reconfiguration; leave open otherwise. Internal pull-up.

pins.name: D_SEL
pins.function: Interface select: unconnected or at VCC gives UART and I2C on pins 18 to 21; at GND gives SPI. Internal pull-up.

pins.name: TIMEPULSE
pins.function: Time pulse output, 1 PPS by default. 4 mA drive and sink.

pins.name: RESET_N
pins.function: Reset, active low. Internal 10 kΩ pull-up.

pins.name: VCC_RF
pins.function: Supply out for an external LNA or active antenna, about VCC - 0.1 V, up to 50 mA.

pins.name: LNA_EN
pins.function: Control output to switch an external antenna or LNA.

pins.name: SDA / SPI CS_N
pins.function: With D_SEL high or unconnected: I2C data. With D_SEL at GND: SPI chip select. Internal pull-up.

pins.name: SCL / SPI SLK
pins.function: With D_SEL high or unconnected: I2C clock. With D_SEL at GND: SPI clock. Internal pull-up.

pins.name: TXD / SPI SDO
pins.function: With D_SEL high or unconnected: UART transmit out of the module. With D_SEL at GND: SPI data out (MISO). Internal pull-up.

pins.name: RXD / SPI SDI
pins.function: With D_SEL high or unconnected: UART receive into the module. With D_SEL at GND: SPI data in (MOSI). Internal pull-up.

pins.name: V_BCKP
pins.function: Backup supply, keeps the RTC and backup RAM alive while VCC is off.

notes: Pins 20 and 21 also go by TXD / SPI MISO and RXD / SPI MOSI.

operation.text: RF_IN goes through an LTE B13 notch, a SAW filter and an LNA to the UBX-M9140-KB GNSS chip, which holds its own LNA, RF front end, fractional-N synthesiser, DSP engine, CPU, RAM, ROM, backup RAM, RTC, power management with a DC/DC converter, and the USB, UART, I2C and SPI ports. A TCXO, an RTC crystal and SPI flash sit beside the chip.
GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou can be tracked together, with SBAS and QZSS. Fewer constellations can be enabled to save power.

D_SEL picks the host port at pins 18 to 21. Left open or high, the pins carry UART and I2C; tied to GND, they carry SPI and neither UART nor I2C is available. USB is separate on pins 5 and 6, powered from V_USB. All digital inputs have pull-ups and can be left open when not used; every PIO level is referred to VCC.
One UART, baud rate configurable from 4800 to 921600 bit/s, 38400 by default. There is no hardware flow control. It is on when D_SEL is open or high.
Off by default; on with D_SEL at GND. Peripheral only, up to 5.5 MHz clock and 125 kB/s. Default mode CPOL = 0, CPHA = 0.
Peripheral only, Fast-mode up to 400 kbit/s; Standard-mode is not supported. The module may stretch SCL low for up to 20 ms, which lowers the throughput. Available only when D_SEL selects UART.
USB 2.0 full speed, 12 Mbit/s, for a host link, supplied from V_USB. Certification of the USB port may not be possible with this hardware.

By default the NMEA output reports satellites in every band received, which raises the NMEA load per navigation period over that of earlier products. The UART baud rate has to carry that load at the chosen navigation rate and number of signals.
The VCC ramp is specified between 20 and 8000 µs/V; ramping faster than this can permanently damage the module.
With VCC off and V_BCKP at 3 V, the backup supply draws 45 µA typ. In software backup mode the current is 0.36 mA typ.
The GNSS chips inside are AEC-Q100 qualified; family qualification tests follow ISO 16750. The module meets the Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU and EU RoHS (2011/65/EU and 2015/863).
